frame.name: Looks Can Kill
frame.description: This weapon fires shield-piercing ammunition and comes with a scope. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Breaking a matched shield or piercing a Champion's barrier will cause the target to ignite.

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.description:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.description:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Death at First Glance
perks.description: Bonus damage when aiming down sights on the opening shot of an attack. This bonus is preserved if the shot deals precision damage or strikes an elemental shield.

perks.name: Polymer Grip
perks.description:
This weapon's grip is made of lighter material.
  •  Increases handling speed

catalyst.name: Eriana's Vow Catalyst
catalyst.description: Increases magazine size. Holstering this weapon automatically reloads it after a short period of time.
